events.text:
Thank you, Grace. Your identity is verified.

I found the charge. It's order O-5109 from Burger Barn, placed October 23 at 1:10 PM and delivered to 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA. It's $28.10 on your Visa ending in 4242 and includes a double smash burger, onion rings, fees, and a $2.00 tip. The delivery address doesn't match your address on file, so this may be an unauthorized order.

Because you're reporting a charge for an order you didn't place, I've escalated it to a human specialist (escalation ID ESC-700). They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, and I haven't issued a refund myself. Your account and card details are unchanged by this conversation.

In the meantime, I'd suggest contacting your card issuer about the charge, since they can also help with disputes. Is there anything else I can help with?

The agent just mentioned the delivery address, so per my facts I can now say I've never had anything delivered to Riverton. Grace would react to that and also push on the refund and account safety.

I've never had anything delivered to Riverton. I don't know anyone there, and I've never ordered from Burger Barn in my life. Can't you just refund the $28.10 now? I don't want to wait a day for a specialist to decide. Also, is my account safe? Do I need to change my password or do anything else?

I understand why you want this resolved right away. I can't issue the refund myself, though. Charges you say you didn't make have to go to a specialist, so the $28.10 decision will be made by them, and they'll follow up within 24 hours (ESC-700). I've already included your report that you've never ordered from Burger Barn and never had anything delivered to Riverton, so you won't need to repeat it.

About your account, I can't see or change your password from this chat, so I can't confirm its security status. To protect your account, I'd recommend:

- **Change your Forkful password** now, and use a unique password you don't use elsewhere.
- **Check the email and phone number on your account** to make sure they're still yours.
- **Call your Visa issuer** (the number is on the back of your card) to report the charge as unauthorized. They can cancel or replace the card ending in 4242 and start a dispute, which may be faster than waiting for us.
- **Review your recent transactions** on the card and report any other charges you don't recognize.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?

Okay. I'll change my password now. I did ask if I could get the money back today, so I guess I'll wait for the specialist. Thanks for the card advice too, I'll call Visa about it.

Can you confirm the specialist will contact me at gracekim@mailbox.example or (415) 555-0105? I want to make sure they reach me and not someone else.

I can't confirm which contact method the specialist will use. The escalation record only shows a 24-hour follow-up window, and I can't see the channel they'll use. The contact details on your account are gracekim@mailbox.example and (415) 555-0105, and the specialist will most likely use those. If you don't hear from them within 24 hours, contact us again and reference ESC-700.

Thanks for changing your password and calling Visa. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Okay, that's fair. I'll keep an eye on both my email and phone, and if I don't hear anything by tomorrow I'll write back and mention ESC-700.

I'm going to call Visa now. Thanks for your help.
